name: hud_duel_lost_orders
description: Duel orders lost on their way (contract-m7.md §3), on Undertow's own rules against the caretaker: a CMD the link drops is never answered (MatchClient._send with the link closed, the server's sequencer after TIMEOUT), so nothing of Game's may wait on it for the rest of the match. In window 9 (two corks; reached by playing wave 8) a CORK dropped on its way waits, counted against the window's corks, until a later order of mine runs: my orders run in their seq's order, so it never will, and it goes, its price no longer held back. A CORK waiting when the link goes (BuildController.forget_pending) keeps its salt, since its turn may still come, but holds back any other cork until it is known (a bottle would take the oldest waiting salt). A cork that stood keeps its salt; one lost at the window's end goes with the window, and the next window has its corks. In wave 9 an UNCORK and a SEAWALL dropped on their way are free to go again once the link goes, or once a later order runs, and Space and F then work: the simulation takes the UNCORK's reveal and the Seawall spends one charge.

steps.msg: a duel against the caretaker
the next horn plays wave 8
window 9: two corks
key 1 corks, and the CORK never reaches the turns

steps.assert: resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').sent(1, 6).is_empty() and Game.corks_left() == 1 and Game.my_bottles().size() == 1 and Game.my_bottles()[0]['waiting'] and not scene.settled()
steps.msg: it waits for a turn that never comes
a tower ordered after it

steps.assert: scene.tower_at(Vector2i(8, 3)) != null and Game.corks_left() == 2 and Game.my_bottles().is_empty() and Game.pending_gold == 0
steps.msg: a later order of mine ran, so the lost CORK never will: it goes, its price no longer held back, and the window has both corks again
key 2 corks, and the CORK is lost again

steps.assert: node('Notice').text == 'Your last cork is still on its way' and Game.corks_left() == 1 and resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').sent(1, 6).is_empty()
steps.msg: the link went while it waited: until it is known, no other cork goes out
another tower ordered
it ran: the unsure CORK is known lost, and corking is open again
key 1 corks, and this one stands
a second cork lost on its way

steps.assert: Game._corks_waiting.is_empty() and Game.my_bottles().size() == 1 and Game.my_bottles()[0]['known'] and Game.corks_left() == 2
steps.msg: the window ended, so the lost CORK went with it; the bottle that stood keeps its salt, and window 10 has both its corks
Space uncorks, and the UNCORK never reaches the turns: nothing left to uncork while it is on its way
it waits

steps.assert: Game.next_to_uncork() == bottle and Game.uncork_refusal() == '' and Game.my_bottles()[0]['uncork'] == -1
steps.msg: the link went: the bottle may be uncorked again, by Space or by itself at 24 s
lives lost: two charges

steps.assert: resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').seawall_lost(scene) and Game.seawall_refusal() == 'The Seawall is still standing'
steps.msg: F bursts a Seawall, and the SEAWALL never reaches the turns
the link went: F may burst again

steps.assert: resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').seawall_lost(scene) and Game.seawall_refusal() == 'The Seawall is still standing'
steps.msg: lost again
a tower ordered after it

steps.assert: scene.tower_at(Vector2i(6, 4)) != null and Game.seawall_refusal() == '' and resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').sent(1, 8).is_empty() and Game.duel_side(0)['charges'] == 2
steps.msg: it ran, so the lost SEAWALL never will: F is free, both charges kept
Space and F go out and run
the UNCORK reveals the salt its CORK committed to
